points.description: States that A and C are not in the same path (i.e. they lie on different paths/branches, so no single path connects A and C). Equivalent wording accepted, e.g. 'A and C are on different branches' or 'no path passes through both A and C'. A bare conclusion with no reference to A and C not being on the same path earns no mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that A and C are not on the same path (different paths/branches). No mark for answers that give no reasoning or give a different reason. The question's context (a diagram) is not available, so judge only on the stated reasoning.
